methods.name: Daniels' Running Formula (VDOT)
methods.signature: VDOT-based pace zones (E/M/T/I/R) with 2 quality sessions per week

methods.name: Pfitzinger / Advanced Marathoning
methods.signature: Lactate threshold-anchored mesocycles with MLR (Medium-Long Run) and LT runs at 15K-HM race pace

methods.name: Hansons Marathon Method
methods.signature: Cumulative fatigue with a 16-mile long-run cap and three quality sessions: Speed, Strength, and Tempo (marathon pace)

methods.name: Hal Higdon Plans
methods.signature: Six-tier accessibility (Novice 1 through Advanced 2) with RPE-driven, simple-language workouts

methods.name: Galloway Run-Walk-Run
methods.signature: Run-Walk-Run intervals throughout every run; Magic Mile time trial as the fitness anchor

methods.name: 80/20 Running (Fitzgerald)
methods.signature: 80% easy / 20% moderate-to-hard volume distribution across a 5-zone HR system

methods.name: Koop / CTS Ultra
methods.signature: Back-to-back long runs on weekends, terrain-specific training, and HR-zone-based intensity prescription

methods.name: Roche / SWAP (Some Work, All Play)
methods.signature: 30-30 strides (30 sec on / 30 sec off) and aerobic threshold-anchored zones, with explicit emphasis on running joyfully

methods.name: TrainingPeaks (Joe Friel / PMC)
methods.signature: ATP periodization + the Performance Management Chart (Fitness / Fatigue / Recovery Balance) to manage load and time the taper
